app.name: ABR
app.descriptor: Verified discovery and connection for graduation projects.

meta.title: ABR · Graduation projects, verified and connected
meta.description: ABR connects verified students with the organizations and mentors who can take their work further. Every project is reviewed, and contact details are shared only when both sides agree.

comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.body: Sign-in and accounts open with our pilot. Register your interest and we'll tell you first.

hero.title: Graduation projects deserve a life after graduation.
hero.subtitle: ABR connects verified students with the organizations and mentors who can take their work further. Every project is reviewed, and contact details are shared only when both sides agree.

card.title: Arabic Speech-to-Text for Clinics
card.summary: Transcribes doctor–patient conversations in Saudi dialects into structured notes.

how.title: How it works

discover.title: Discover
discover.body: Organizations browse reviewed projects from verified students.

request.title: Request
request.body: A verified organization sends a structured request. No contact details are shared.

decide.title: Decide
decide.body: The student accepts or declines. Declining reveals nothing.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Each side sees the contact details the other agreed to share.

how.intro: Five steps, and your contact details stay private until you say yes.

who.title: Built for everyone around a graduation project

points.publish: Publish your project on a reviewed, professional page
points.control: You decide who gets your contact details

points.browse: Browse projects reviewed by the ABR team
points.verified: Every student has a verified university email
points.requests: Send structured requests; contact unlocks on acceptance

mentors.title: Mentors
mentors.note: Mentor workflows open after the pilot.

points.contact: Contact shared only for accepted mentorships

who.intro: One platform, three roles, each with its own verified path.

trust.title: Trust is built in, not added later

students.title: Verified students
students.body: Students join with an email from a participating university.

projects.title: Reviewed projects
projects.body: The ABR team reviews every project before it is published.

organizations.title: Verified organizations
organizations.body: Organizations are verified before they can send requests.

privacy.title: Private by default
privacy.body: Contact details unlock only after a request is accepted, and every access is logged.

trust.intro: Every safeguard is enforced by the platform itself, not left to chance.

join.question: Who can join?
join.answer: Students with an email from a participating university, organizations after verification, and mentors.

university.question: My university isn't listed. What can I do?
university.answer: You can request it during sign-up, and we'll review it.
university.answerInterest: Choose “Other” in the interest form and write its name.

contact.question: When are my contact details shared?
contact.answer: Only after you accept a request, and only the details you chose to share.

messaging.question: Can I message people on ABR?
messaging.answer: Not in this version. Once a connection is approved, you continue by email or phone.

cta.title: Give your project the audience it deserves.
cta.subline: Your contact details stay private until you accept a request.
